svg.text: D05 | Underfloor link, rails and manufacturing notes
PR 2564 / FC1 | ORIGINAL DESIGN | dimensions mm unless stated
Revision FC1 construction drawing. Prototype not yet built; calibration records blank. Dimension labels govern; do not scale.
MIT original assets. No vendor CAD. Assembly dimensions and acceptance in ASSEMBLY.md.
LOCAL PLAN: under the 3 mm floor; no gears in the paper space.
Width pinion U0,V140; rack pitch lines V130/150. Gear envelope Z=-9..-3; actual 5.8 face Z=-8.9..-3.1.
Phase rack attachments against 218 gauge. Relative lost-motion target <=0.20.
CUSTOM PINION: m1, 20 teeth, 20 deg, 6 face, 6.1 bore; face 5.8, pitch dia 20, OD22.
Custom rack pitch pi (3.1416).
Addendum 1, dedendum 1.25.
20-deg straight rack flanks.
Root: radial flank from base dia 18.79
to root dia 17.50; corners cutter R0.25 max.
20 teeth > 17-tooth undercut limit at 20 deg:
all tooth contact is on the involute.
Lock racks: width U-142..-56, V135..145, Z top=-16;
length U-5..5, V201..390, Z top=-29. 35-high plinth encloses mechanism.
Transfer-drill supports square to shaft datums. No vendor hole pattern assumed.
Split-bush drag is dry friction; no 30 N s/m viscous equivalence is asserted.
Model limitations: masses, tooth phase, drag and linkage compliance are unmeasured.
